new.brief: Creates a new string sorter that compares items using the given `expression`.
new.md:
Creates a new string sorter that compares items using the given
`expression`.

Unless an expression is set on it, this sorter will always
compare items as invalid.

doc.md:
Sorts items by comparing strings.

To obtain the strings to compare, this sorter evaluates a
[`Expression`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Expression).

It does the comparison in a linguistically correct way using the
current locale by normalizing Unicode strings and possibly case-folding
them before performing the comparison.

get_collation.brief: Gets which collation method the sorter uses.
get_collation.md: Gets which collation method the sorter uses.

get_expression.brief: Gets the expression that is evaluated to obtain strings from items.
get_expression.md: Gets the expression that is evaluated to obtain strings from items.

get_ignore_case.brief: Gets whether the sorter ignores case differences.
get_ignore_case.md: Gets whether the sorter ignores case differences.

set_collation.brief: Sets the collation method to use for sorting.
set_collation.md: Sets the collation method to use for sorting.

set_expression.brief: Sets the expression that is evaluated to obtain strings from items.
set_expression.md:
Sets the expression that is evaluated to obtain strings from items.

The expression must have the type %G_TYPE_STRING.

set_ignore_case.brief: Sets whether the sorter will ignore case differences.
set_ignore_case.md: Sets whether the sorter will ignore case differences.

collation.brief: The collation method to use for sorting.
collation.md:
The collation method to use for sorting.

The `GTK_COLLATION_NONE` value is useful when the expression already
returns collation keys, or strings that need to be compared byte-by-byte.

The default value, `GTK_COLLATION_UNICODE`, compares strings according
to the [Unicode collation algorithm](https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr10/).

expression.brief: The expression to evaluate on item to get a string to compare with.
expression.md: The expression to evaluate on item to get a string to compare with.
